description: Intent contract for the Git handoff. Written by Claude Code on milestone completion; consumed by scripts/handoff/Invoke-TaskOutput.ps1. See .claude/state/TASK_OUTPUT.md for rationale. JSON carries INTENT (what to commit, why, merge policy). Repo + command output + CI carry STATE (file list, branch, green-ness). The script never trusts intent where it can observe state.

closes_issues.description: Issue identifiers this milestone closes, e.g. ['#4']. Appended to the PR body as 'Closes #4'.

commit_message.description: Full Conventional Commits message INCLUDING type/scope (e.g. 'feat(deployment): ...'). The script does NOT derive this from the diff - type, scope, and the WHY belong to intent, and the diff cannot recover them. Body lines may reference ADRs/issues inline.

labels.description: GitHub labels applied to the PR after creation.

merge_policy.description: 'manual' (recommended default): script opens PR, waits CI green, STOPS - human merges. 'auto-on-green': script squashes + deletes branch automatically once checks are green. Choose 'manual' unless you have explicitly decided to remove the last human gate.

pr_body.description: PR description body. Lead with the WHY; the WHAT is recoverable from the diff. Optionally include a checklist of what was done. The script surfaces CI results separately (live state, not recorded claims).

pr_title.description: PR title. Also used to derive the branch name when the script starts from main (kebab-cased, prefixed feat/).

reviewers.description: Reviewer handles/usernames (reserved for v1; auto-assignment from here is forward-compatible).

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Bump when fields are added/removed/renamed. Script locates .claude/state/schema/v{N}.schema.json from this value so old handoffs validate against the schema written for them. Migrations documented in TASK_OUTPUT.md.

status.description: Lifecycle of THIS handoff. The Stop hook only fires the Git chain when status='completed'. 'draft'/'in-progress' are soft no-ops (script exits 2). Only the most recent task-output.json is authoritative.

task.description: Milestone / task identifier, e.g. 'M6-deployment'. Human context only; the script does not parse it.

commands_run_locally.description: Recording of which verification commands Claude ran locally BEFORE marking status=completed. INFORMATIONAL ONLY - the script does NOT trust these results. Under the confirmed CI-only policy, the script waits on required GitHub Actions checks rather than re-running here.

title: task-output.json v1
